svg.title: letsauth: authentication for agents, measured instead of asserted
svg.desc: The letsauth wordmark beside a thumbnail of the MCP auth atlas: 39 public MCP servers across, 23 requirements of the MCP Authorization specification down, each observed cell coloured by status.
